title: Örtliches Auslegungskonzept gegen Pittingversagen bei randschichtgehärteten Zahnrädern
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: The current design of gears against pitting fatigue is based on simple physical models in combination with empirically determined factors. In contrast to that, this work presents a new design concept against pitting fatigue which is based on local quantities and allows a more detailed consideration of different influence parameters on the expected pitting life.
